text:
Nina Ortiz: Heads-up: Candidate Aisha Noor (Backend SWE) is in CET and asked for a coworking pickup rather than home shipping for security reasons.
Ethan Park: Coworking pickup ok as long as partner hub supports ID check & signature. Which hub?
Samira (Recruiter): Candidate listed 'WeWork Berlin Mitte' as preferred pickup. She can pick up Mon or Wed next week between 11:00-15:00 CET. Also flagged FYI: needs background-check link completed before device release.
Nina Ortiz: OK. PeopleOps policy requires LOA signed + background clearance before release. Samira, please confirm LOA sent & BG status.
Samira (Recruiter): LOA emailed 2025-11-04 14:12 CET and signed copy uploaded to candidate record. BG form sent, candidate started but not finished. I'll nudge.
Jules: For hub pickup we need partner contact + pickup code. I'll need a 24-48h window to coordinate.
PeopleOps Bot: reminder: Coworking pickup requires partner confirmation and photo ID on pickup. See https://redwood/internal/coworking-pickups.
Ethan Park: Panel scheduling note: Candidate prefers interviews only between 11:00-15:00 CET. Panel is mostly PDT folks. 11:00 CET = 02:00 PDT (previous day). That's early but doable with volunteers.
Nina Ortiz: Can we offer hybrid: two synchronous interviews + one recorded take-home? Keeps panel sane.
Alex: I can do 02:00 PDT for tech loop if needed, but prefer we avoid asking more people. Recorded take-home for system design ok.
Samira (Recruiter): Candidate can do Mon 2026-06-08 12:00 CET for core panel (that's 03:00 PDT). She confirmed willingness to join that early.
Jules: I'll contact WeWork Berlin to request pickup window 11:30-12:30 CET (their local staff shift change is 12:00). Partner contact: wework-ops@partner.co, you must include "Redwood pickup" + candidate name in subject.
Nina Ortiz: Logistics checklist to include in invite and shipping note: `- LOA signed - BG clearance pending (must finish 24h prior) - Partner hub email confirmation - Pickup code & ID required - Device image + checklist on handover`
PeopleOps Bot: Note: Background clearance must be completed in Greenhouse before asset release. Trigger URL: https://redwood/internal/bg-checks (automated status updates to this thread enabled).
Samira (Recruiter): Candidate completed BG at 2026-06-05 09:18 CET. Status: clear. I'll attach cleared badge to candidate record.
Jules: WeWork replied: pickup approved. Please include pickup window and the following text in subject: "Redwood pickup - Aisha Noor - Pickup code: RW-8421". They require ID and signature.
Ethan Park: Panel volunteers: Alex (can do 03:00 PDT), Morgan (declined early hours), Priya (can do if compensated with flex), and Jules (ops) will observe. We need one more interviewer; Nina, can you cover if needed?
Nina Ortiz: I can join but prefer to take the recorded design exercise instead. I'll backstop live interview only if absolutely necessary.
Samira (Recruiter): Sending invite: Mon 2026-06-08 12:00 CET (core loop). Adding pickup details, LOA confirmation, and checklist. Candidate replied: "Ok for 12:00 CET and I'll pick up device at WeWork 11:30-12:30. Thanks." :thumbsup:
Jules: I'll prepare partner instructions and asset tag RW-2026-671. Please note loaner is encrypted & set to enterprise VPN only.
PeopleOps Bot: Asset tag RW-2026-671 created. Loaner policy reminder: device release requires verified BG status and signed LOA.
Ethan Park: One more item: include a short troubleshooting section in the invite for the candidate: `-- confirm VPN login 15m prior -- verify meeting link and camera 10m prior -- contact ops: wework-ops@partner.co or eng-ops@redwood.com`
Samira (Recruiter): All set. Candidate confirmed pickup and interview slot. Thanks team.
Nina Ortiz: Great. I'll log post-interview satisfaction survey for candidate experience and flag any ops notes. Thanks everyone.
